reply_text:
I found no new dated predictions from Shane Legg in 2025. The only dated claim whose wording I could read on a page I opened is already in your recorded files. That page is podwise.ai's partial third-party transcript of his 11 December 2025 Google DeepMind podcast with Hannah Fry. In it Legg says minimal AGI "could be one year, it could be five years, I'm guessing probably about two or so". That matches `2025-12-11-legg-minimal-agi-about-two-years.toml` and `2025-12-11-legg-minimal-agi-one-to-five-years.toml`.

**Claims I could not confirm in his own words:**
- **"50% chance of AGI by 2028":** this is the most-reported line from that episode. I saw it only in podwise's own summary and chapter notes, and in search snippets of Legg's X and LinkedIn posts. Both sites refused to open, so I have not quoted it.
- **Full AGI "within a decade" (already recorded):** this also appears only in podwise's summary, not in his transcribed words.
- **"50% chance of AGI in the next 3 years!":** this undated post is quoted by ControlAI and LessWrong. I could not open the original or confirm its date, so it is left out.

**Other things to check:**
- **Two undated lines about when AGI arrives.** "I think that's coming in a few years, unclear exactly" is on spoken.md. "Some years from now, AIs will become so generally capable … people will just talk about them as being AGI" is on podwise.
- **The two transcripts don't match word for word.** Spoken.md and the two podwise pages word the same passages a little differently, so a checker may find small differences against the audio.
- **Budget.** I used 9 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings. Three of the openings failed: two X posts and one LinkedIn post that sites refused to open.
